issue.body:
Maybe this is just missing in the documentation but I can not figure out how to use the test client for graphql subscriptions. The documentation of the websocket support of the test client (https://www.starlette.io/testclient/) is stating that it
>  Takes the same set of arguments as requests.get().

However in graphql I have to send post requests with payload. Is there a way to do this with the current test client and thereby use it for graphql subscriptions?
issue.title: Test client support for graphql subcriptions
